$comment: StablePay colour tokens. The three brand hues are read directly out of
brand/logo/stablepay-logo.svg -- the logo is the source of truth, not this
file. The neutral and semantic ramps document colours already shipping in
`contrastOnWhite` / `contrastOnInk` are WCAG 2.1 ratios. AA body text needs
4.5, AA large text (>=18.66px bold or >=24px) needs 3.0, non-text UI needs 3.0.

signalBlue.role: Primary. Interactive elements, links, the 'Pay' in the wordmark.
signalBlue.usage: Safe for body text on white.

beaconYellow.role: Accent only. Highlights, illustration, the logo's lower-left disc.
beaconYellow.usage: NEVER text on white. Use as a fill behind ink-coloured text.

emberOrange.role: Accent. Warnings, the logo's lower-right disc.
emberOrange.usage: Not for body text on white. Large bold text or fills only.

logoAsRendered.$comment: The brand hues composited over the logo's white underlay. These are what a colour-picker reports when sampling the PNG. Documented so nobody 'corrects' the palette to match a screenshot.

neutral.$comment: Cool-tinted grey ramp, already in use across the widget.

knownIssues.detail: semantic.accent (#F6941C, inherited from the Stability Nexus palette) and brand.emberOrange (#FD6724, from the logo) are two different oranges doing overlapping jobs in the same UI. Pick one before the final evaluation; #F6941C currently appears in PricingCard.css.
